card.name: Percent sign in patient counts
card.fires_on: The percent sign right after a number in parentheses that follows a small patient count, as in "7 (0.2%) patients". It appears in adverse-event reports from clinical trials.

modes.label: Count with percent
modes.description: The % closing a parenthetical percentage after an event count, just before the word patients or participants.
modes.example: Bullous pemphigoid was reported in 7 (0.2<<%)>> patients treated with linagliptin compared

card.plain: It marks the percent sign after a small count of patients who had a side effect in a trial.
